name: Measured Editorial
intent: A restrained editorial system for evidence-driven Databricks engineering content.
principles: Use one technical idea per image.
Keep generous negative space and a tactile paper surface.
Use color to encode meaning, not decoration.

teal.use: Handled outcomes and matched business state

rules: Use bold weight for measured numbers and state names.
Keep text out of generated illustrations.

brand.source: Official Databricks Brandfolder full-color horizontal lockup
brand.placement: Upper right on every article-facing image, sized to 10.5% of canvas width with 3% outer clear space
rules: Use the official full-color lockup without recoloring, distortion, or reconfiguration.
Keep the logo subordinate to the measured result or article title.
Do not use the logo as a decorative pattern or imply official Databricks authorship.

composition.style: Swiss editorial geometry with Japanese print restraint
composition.texture: Uncoated paper, light letterpress indentation, restrained physical shadow
composition.thumbnail: Use a 1200x630 crop of the article hero. Set the direct article title in the upper-left quiet space using ink-black type with a muted subtitle. Keep the focal event split right of center. Add only the official Databricks lockup at the upper right; do not add a kicker, badge, slogan, or filler text.
composition.charts: Use a bone canvas, paper cards, black text, thin outlines, a single semantic accent per mark, and the official Databricks lockup at the upper right.

prompt_suffix: Measured Editorial style: warm bone paper, ink-black geometry, muted mineral teal, ochre, vermilion, and dusty violet; tactile screenprint and letterpress restraint; generous negative space; no generated text or logos, neon, circuits, glossy 3D, glassmorphism, or generic technology imagery. Apply the official Databricks lockup separately as an exact production asset.
